Build local memory, project tracker, router, and terminal chat.

Add safe local brain/router and project backup/scan ops inspired by ELIE.
Install Python 3.10+ and verify recovered Lucy commands.
Add session-only NVIDIA key prompt, local learning loop, and NVIDIA memory fallback tool.
Finish Stage 17 checks, run tests, and back up after acceptance.
